timeline.text: A parent's dashboard said the child was acing grammar, week after week.
But a failed round could just be retried until it passed, hiding the real score.
On his actual first answers, grammar sat at fifty percent - the same as pure guessing.
A single TypeScript rule now checks every answer the same way, and a wrong one gets a real second try.
Maths mistakes now get corrected on retry sixty-five percent of the time, up from just sixteen.
